## Caught Our Eye

#### Sovereignty group claims $40M lobbying total

Posted by Caleb Mynatt on Aug. 11, 2025

If lobbying filings are to be believed, a sovereignty group spent $20 million lobbying in Q2, more than eight times the next biggest lobbying contract.

The State of Loc Nation Global Public Benefit Corp., which claims to be a self-governed nation with its own currency and central bank, reports $40 million in federal lobbying so far in 2025. All of its filings run through an affiliated registrant, Loc Community Association. The group is led by Rev. Dr. Christina Clement, the self-proclaimed "Her Highness Empress Queen" of SoLNGPBC. Its mission, according to its own materials, is "to build and defend a sovereign, justice-centered nation" for historically oppressed people.

If the group's extraordinary spending claims are to be believed, Loc Nation's second quarter figure would top the list of spending on external lobbying contracts, surpassing the U.S. Chamber of Commerce's total of $19.34 million and far exceeding major players like the National Association of Realtors ($16.08 million) and Business Roundtable ($9.18 million). The Q2 total would also be a few million larger than the revenue total amassed by major firms like Brownstein Hyatt Farber Schreck LLP and BGR Government Affairs LLC.

This wouldn't be the first time the group has made unusual claims regarding their political or legal status. Clement has also claimed to have secured a $500 quadrillion legal judgment and land rights for 1.4 trillion people in a lawsuit against then-U.S. Attorney General Merrick Garland. Federal court records show the case was dismissed without any such ruling.

Subjects: [Merrick Brian Garland](https://www.legistorm.com/person/bio/99655/Merrick_Brian_Garland.html); [Christina Loren Clement](https://www.legistorm.com/person/bio/508414/Christina_Loren_Clement.html); [U.S. Chamber of Commerce](https://www.legistorm.com/organization/summary/33923/U_S_Chamber_of_Commerce.html); [Business Roundtable Inc.](https://www.legistorm.com/organization/summary/34410/Business_Roundtable_Inc_.html); [National Association of Realtors](https://www.legistorm.com/organization/summary/36028/National_Association_of_Realtors.html); [Brownstein Hyatt Farber Schreck LLP](https://www.legistorm.com/organization/summary/44966/Brownstein_Hyatt_Farber_Schreck_LLP.html); [BGR Government Affairs LLC](https://www.legistorm.com/organization/summary/100826/BGR_Government_Affairs_LLC.html); [State of Loc Nation Global Public Benefit Corp.](https://www.legistorm.com/organization/summary/201995/State_of_Loc_Nation_Global_Public_Benefit_Corp_.html); [Loc Community Association](https://www.legistorm.com/organization/summary/202001/Loc_Community_Association.html)
